summary: Actual insertion stopped before the planned release endpoint because one held-arm tetrahedron collapsed below the unchanged5% volume limit. A separate serialization error then prevented report.json/coupling_trace.json; this report preserves that missing evidence.

failure.shape_interpretation: Positive but extreme local flattening: one principal stretch2.9306% while the other two are155.37%/95.75%; rest mean-ratio quality0.4764 is not a near-zero initial sliver.

execution_boundary.event_file_limit: events.json was last persisted at transport end; archived candidate and exact source identify the interrupted insert. No missing execution event is fabricated.

bounded_raw_native_reactions.source: contact_guard_trace.json, actual bounded interval only; no fabricated full report

contact_evidence.interpretation: Direct cloth compression of tet895 is excluded by45.4mm whole-tet/all-cloth separation at failure. Its material position near the held right-arm patch, sustained opposing finger forces and sub-mm FK-reference left-finger-pad proximity support local gripping compression while remote foot/head cloth contact constrains the body. The actual late IPC affine finger surface was not saved, so exact pad indentation and unique causality are not proven.
contact_evidence.remote_contacts: Five actual saved shapes show right-foot/front-panel and head-or-muzzle/back-panel gaps about1.25–1.27mm and free-rear-strap/head about1.37–1.49mm; held front strap remains separated. These near distances are not force-closure or topological-hook proofs.

earlier_release_assessment.scope: Only15 declared actual observations; no new stop/release or arbitrary scan.
earlier_release_assessment.conclusion: At1.14m and1.125m dozens of head/ear nodes are already below every rim point minus2mm yet outside the physical-body degree region. Positive horizontal COM margin therefore does not establish lower-body capture. The first selected all-low-unit sample is only0.14s before failure, still original COM-outside; it does not justify dropping from1.14m.

physical_next_step_recommendation.preferred: Improve long-axis alignment with the actual bag opening before another descent, keeping current grasp/materials and all existing release/final gates. The separately authorized world-Z+25degree replacement is a concrete candidate to test under the original geometry/IK/rate/soft-sweep and native gates; this report does not certify its route.
physical_next_step_recommendation.why: Significant head/ear projection outside and low-region outside nodes reveal orientation/capture error, while the robot continues to squeeze a locally trapped grasp patch during remote cloth contact. Smaller net force/torque or slower motion alone does not bound local FEM collapse.
physical_next_step_recommendation.not_recommended_from_this_evidence: Do not lower the J limit, declare success frompartial capture, or replace3D release capture with only COM projection/25percent nodes. Do not blindly weaken the grip without a fresh retention check.
physical_next_step_recommendation.future_controller_option_only_if_alignme: A distinct compliant unloading/release controller would need an explicitly checked actual capture/contact state and a fresh bounded native trial; it is not established by these moving-through frames.

limitations: Original valid cap is not an embedding/self-intersection certificate; invalid cap means unknown, never measured zero.
Low-region integer/cap agreement assumes an embedded physical body for inside interpretation. Body self-intersection is not certified here.
Projected COM/footprint capture does not imply three-dimensional containment, stable support, or a collision-free drop.
Node fractions are not volume fractions or whole-tetrahedron containment.
Failure soft state has no measured robotTCP/q. Matching actualjointtrace permits FK reference only; guardAIM is commanded reference, not actual native affine pose.
Different deliberately stopped/released trajectories alter contact dynamics; these actual moving samples cannot certify a new stop or release.

Mean/highcap disagree for COM above the lowest rim, so original COM-outside is the existing validator result rather than a cap-independent physical theorem. Low-region evidence is stronger but still assumes embedded bag body.
Global force and torque sums can remain small while opposing contact forces create high local strain.
Late native IPC affine robot geometry is unavailable because coupling_trace was not written.
The independent full execution auditor remains incomplete due missing report.json; no partial file reconstruction can make native task success true.
